notes.title: from view v1.1.0
notes.content:
A small update to add a settings menu so you can adjust rendering quality if you need to for performance reasons.

If you've been experiencing poor performance I recommend first reducing the [b]Post Processing[/b] quality to [b]High[/b] or lower. The [b]Very High[/b] and [b]Extreme[/b] settings use a significantly more expensive post processing setup. You can tune other settings afterwards if you need to.

Hopefully this will help out any folks who have been having performance issues.

Thanks for playing "from view"!
